definitions.denominator: All original sessions, identical to coverage.json; unknown retained and reported.
definitions.initial_hit: First trigger-condition hit at observed assistant decision 1.
definitions.late_gt_d: First hit after decision d, divided by all sessions (not conditional on survival).
definitions.single_request_delayed: First hit at step >1 and before the first observed decision with >=2 user messages.
definitions.early_le_d: First hit by decision d; predicate presence, not detection rate or model activation.
definitions.scope: Lexical user-content scopes and all thresholds are inherited unchanged from the original scan.
